feedback:
1. (Judgment 4) The Selected Work index is missing from the page. The 1440 gold field holds only LIONS, "by 25" and "FINAL · 35–10" above a large empty span. The 360 filmstrip runs hero → nav → signals → identity and ends after two folds. The Mobile Declaration's `order` calls for selected work and the site callout between the signals band and the footer line. Build the three-column work index (`repeat(3, 1fr)`, `3xl` titles, `borderStrong` break above it) inside the gold field below the hero, and stack it after the bronze band at 360.

2. (Judgment 3) Because the index is missing, the declared `rhythm: accelerating` never happens. The page is sparse air with no tightening into the work, so the eye has nowhere to go after the hero but the rail. Run the work rows on shrinking intervals as the brief specifies (spacious hero, tighter index), using FishSticks, 15th Club and dougmar.ch from the records with their actual roles and years.

3. (Judgment 5) Whatever titles, roles and years the new index carries must match the records exactly:
   - FishSticks: Founder & Builder, 2025, Live.
   - 15th Club: Founder & Builder, 2025, In Development.
   - dougmar.ch: Designer & Builder, 2026, Live.

   Do not invent descriptions beyond the records.

6. Header placement: the declaration puts the mark at the head of the bronze rail with a 420px header. At 1440 the mark floats mid-rail at about y=268, and WORK / ABOUT / CONTACT start near y=525, so the header block runs about 630px with roughly 250px of empty bronze above the mark. Pin the mark to the top of the rail with the nav list directly beneath it, inside about 420px. Let the golf leaderboard and the day's facts follow in the first fold so the rail reads as the declared signal spine rather than a dark void.

1. Freshness: tonight repeats 2026-11-08 ("Ben James leads at −21"). Both use gold near 50° on a duotone ground with a dark marginal rail, accelerating rhythm, caps, and a golf leaderboard in the rail. Tonight also reuses 11-12's exact composition tuple (three/horizontal/left-weighted/marginal/field-dominant/rail-to-band). The wide Unbounded LIONS is new, but a returning visitor could take this for the 11-08 scoreboard page. Push the gold field and bronze spine further from 11-08's look, for example by making the rail's material or the margin figure's role unmistakably different.

4. Phone order: the Mobile Declaration ends with "site callout, footer line." At 360 the "Doug March · Independent design & engineering · 2026" identity line sits at the foot of the bronze band, ahead of Selected Work. Either move that line after the callout or keep it in the band and make the declared order match.

[check 2] The largest first-fold text measures 190px at 1440; the declared hero_scale clamp(72px, 11vw, 148px) resolves to 148px there (128%, over the 75-125% band). Set the hero element's font-size to exactly clamp(72px, 11vw, 148px).

1. (Judgment 3) The `hero_object` is `word`, so LIONS must lead, with "by 25" one step down as its deck. At 1440 the burnt-orange "25" is set at poster scale. Its glyphs stand taller and heavier than LIONS, and the accent colour pulls the eye to the number first, so the page reads as a `figure` hero. Set "by 25" as the declared `2xl` deck beneath LIONS, keep only the 25 in accent, and let LIONS be the single dominant mass. The same inversion shows at 360, where 25 nearly matches LIONS.

2. (Judgment 1) The page repeats 2026-11-12 on more than one trait. It shares the same silhouette: three columns, horizontal, left-weighted, a marginal dark right rail holding the mark, a ruled upper-case nav list and the signals, on a field-dominant duotone that collapses rail-to-band. It also shares the same type register: caps, heavy, left, no texture. With the gold-duotone scoreboard rail of 2026-11-08 also close by, a returning visitor would read this as a recolour of those nights. Break the silhouette at least: move the rail off the right edge, or give the hero field a different structure from the rail-plus-index strip.
